title: From supplied build commands to EC2 deployment
summary: Match supplied phase commands and generated output selection; verify both phase logs and exported files. Keep revision, intended targets, AppSpec mappings, hook results and target files connected.

steps.title: Configure a CodeBuild buildspec for a supplied application

blocks.text: A buildspec describes commands and artifacts in YAML. Version 0.2 supports commands in the same shell environment.
Put supplied commands in commands lists under needed phases, such as install, pre_build, build and post_build.
Match artifacts.files and, when needed, base-directory to generated output. Inspect phase logs and the exported artifact.

left.code:
cat <<'YAML'
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - mkdir -p dist
      - cp supplied-release.txt dist/release.txt
artifacts:
  base-directory: dist
  files: [release.txt]
YAML

annotations.text: Supplied build-phase commands list generates dist/release.txt.
Artifact selection: release.txt within base-directory dist.

right.title: Illustrative supplied case
right.alt_text: Illustrative supplied case: Build phase: commands succeeded; Generated file: dist/release.txt; Exported artifact contains: release.txt

blocks.takeaway: Compare the generated path with the selected file.

steps.title: Command success is not verified artifact export.

blocks.text: For delivery-api, compare the generated output path literally with artifact selection. If commands succeed but the selected path misses the generated file, export is not verified. Do not add unfamiliar commands merely to fill every phase.

public.prompt: Phase logs show the supplied build commands succeeded, but the exported artifact has not been inspected. Which conclusion is justified?

options.text: Command success is known; intended artifact export still needs verification.
Successful commands prove the intended file was exported.
Artifact selection is irrelevant once commands succeed.

o1.message: Correct. Artifact paths must match generated output, and the exported artifact must be inspected.

o2.message: Not supported. Artifact paths must match generated output, and the exported artifact must be inspected.

o3.message: Not supported. Artifact paths must match generated output, and the exported artifact must be inspected.

steps.title: Review buildspec evidence
steps.lede: Read the supplied excerpts in this step and decide which claims or configurations are correct, defective or unsafe.

public.prompt: Read each independent supplied evidence excerpt and its reviewer decision. Decide whether that decision is supported by the evidence and the verification requirements, or unsupported. A supported decision may correctly identify a failure; it does not always mean the operation succeeded.

items.text:
```text
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - mkdir -p dist
      - cp supplied-release.txt dist/release.txt
artifacts:
  base-directory: dist
  files: [release.txt]
Phase log: both supplied commands succeeded.
Generated: dist/release.txt
Export inspection: release.txt retained and matches generated file.
Reviewer decision: Commands, output selection and export inspection meet the supplied requirement.
```

```text
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - mkdir -p dist
      - cp supplied-release.txt dist/release.txt
artifacts:
  base-directory: dist
  files: [other.txt]
Phase log: both supplied commands succeeded.
Generated: dist/release.txt
Export inspection: intended release.txt absent.
Reviewer decision: Accept as complete because phase commands succeeded.
```

```text
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - mkdir -p dist
      - cp supplied-release.txt dist/release.txt
artifacts:
  base-directory: dist
  files: [release.txt]
Phase log: cp command failed.
Generated: dist/release.txt
Export inspection: not performed.
Reviewer decision: Accept without phase or export follow-up.
```

item1.message: The command list produces dist/release.txt, selected relative to dist and confirmed in the export.

item2.message: Successful commands do not repair selection of the wrong output file.

item3.message: The supplied commands must succeed and the intended exported file must be verified.

correct.message: Compare every review decision with the supplied settings and observed results; keep discrepancies visible.

incorrect.message: Compare every review decision with the supplied settings and observed results; keep discrepancies visible.

steps.title: Configure a CodeDeploy deployment action for a supplied EC2 application

blocks.text: For EC2, appspec.yml maps revision files to destinations and lists lifecycle-hook scripts.
Use the supplied application and deployment group to identify intended EC2 targets and revision, with the approved service role and installed agent.
Inspect AppSpec mappings and hooks; execute the supplied action, then verify hook results and application files on the target.

public.prompt: The approved deployment is revision-A on approved-node-1, but the action selected revision-B on that target. Which verification conclusion is justified?

options.text: The correct target alone proves the intended revision was selected.
An installed agent makes revision comparison unnecessary.
Target selection matches, but revision alignment fails; retain the mismatch.

o1.message: Not supported. The deployment must use both the intended target set and the intended revision; the agent does not replace that comparison.

o2.message: Not supported. The deployment must use both the intended target set and the intended revision; the agent does not replace that comparison.

o3.message: Correct. The deployment must use both the intended target set and the intended revision; the agent does not replace that comparison.

steps.lede: Read the supplied excerpts in this step and decide which claims or configurations are correct, defective or unsafe.

public.prompt: Read each independent supplied evidence excerpt and its reviewer decision. Decide whether that decision is supported by the evidence and the verification requirements, or unsupported. items.text:
```text
Approval: application delivery-api; group delivery-sandbox; target approved-node-1; revision revision-A; role delivery-deploy-role; agent installed.
Selected deployment: all approved values above.
appspec.yml: release.txt maps to /opt/delivery-api; AfterInstall uses scripts/check-release.sh.
revision-A on approved-node-1: AfterInstall succeeded; inspected /opt/delivery-api/release.txt matches revision-A.
Reviewer decision: Accept: selection, hook results and destination file all match.
```

```text
Approval: application delivery-api; group delivery-sandbox; target approved-node-1; revision revision-A; role delivery-deploy-role; agent installed.
Selected deployment: revision-B; all other approved values match.
appspec.yml: release.txt maps to /opt/delivery-api; AfterInstall uses scripts/check-release.sh.
revision-A on approved-node-1: AfterInstall succeeded; inspected /opt/delivery-api/release.txt matches revision-A.
Reviewer decision: Accept the deployment as the intended revision.
```

```text
Approval: application delivery-api; group delivery-sandbox; target approved-node-1; revision revision-A; role delivery-deploy-role; agent installed.
Selected deployment: all approved values above.
appspec.yml: release.txt maps to /opt/delivery-api; AfterInstall uses scripts/check-release.sh.
revision-A on approved-node-1: AfterInstall failed; inspected /opt/delivery-api/release.txt does not match revision-A.
Reviewer decision: Keep both failures as evidence and do not mark deployment completed.
```

item1.message: The intended revision and target are backed by hook and AppSpec destination evidence.

item2.message: The selected revision differs from the supplied revision even with the correct target.

item3.message: A failed hook and file mismatch must remain visible rather than count as completion.
